title: Cab's valets and the ammonia stick after late nights
summary: Cab had three valets; after a night out his valet Rudolph put him in a cold shower and held ammonia under his nose in the wings during "Minnie the Moocher".

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: But you see, what he had, see we had three valets. Now, one was just to take care of him, see, and this valet, see, he'd be hanging, drunk, and that valet, Rudolph, he'd take him in there and put him in the shower, cold shower, And then, he'd go out there and shake his head on "Minnie the Moocher" And every now and then he'd feel dizzy and he'd run to the wing, and Rudolph would stick that ammonia on a stick, stick it under his nose, you know, and that would straighten him up again.
Oh, yeah, a stick filled with ammonia.
You mean after Cab had been out late that night?
Yeah, all night. And maybe he'd feel a little -- you know, his head might be swimming a little from drinking.
Well, I wouldn't have thought he was as regular as that, to go out with you and Tyree.
Well, he'd do that at times. He'd pick who he'd want to take out, you know.
